claim.evidence_quote: cache[page] = predict(t, page)  # refresh on every request

conditions.description: Gaussian noise sd 5 on the true next-request time
conditions.label: Accurate predictions (sd 5)

explanations.statement: Fresh predictions help only when they are accurate; with noisy predictions, refreshing on every request adds noise to every hit and hurts.
Prediction noise does not change the effect of refresh timing.

plan.factor: Prediction noise (both implementations measured on each trace)
plan.implementation_note: Each call runs both uploaded simulate() functions on the same trace and predictions.

metrics.description: Authors' misses minus the reproduction's misses on the same trace (positive: refreshing helps).
metrics.label: Misses saved by refreshing

plan.question: Does refreshing on every request help with accurate predictions and hurt with noisy ones?
plan.title: Does the refresh effect depend on prediction quality?
